"""Pytest suite for the group_run API.

Every test takes the scaffold-provided ``client`` fixture from conftest.py.
An autouse fixture resets module-level store state before each test so that
every case is order-independent.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _reset_store(client):
    """Reset in-memory stores before each test for isolation."""
    client.reset()
    yield


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _create_run(client, **overrides):
    """Create a run via POST /runs and return the parsed body (201)."""
    payload = {
        "title": "Sunrise 5K",
        "datetime": "2025-08-15T07:00:00Z",
        "location": "Riverside Park",
        "distance": "5K",
        "pace_target": "9:00-10:00/mi",
        "route_notes": "Meet at the north gate",
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    resp = client.post("/runs", json=payload)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    return resp.json()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POST /runs — create
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_create_run_returns_generated_id_and_submitted_fields(client):
    """A successful create returns a generated id and every submitted field."""
    body = _create_run(client)

    # generated, non-empty id
    assert isinstance(body["id"], str)
    assert len(body["id"]) > 0

    # required fields echo back
    assert body["title"] == "Sunrise 5K"
    assert body["datetime"] == "2025-08-15T07:00:00Z"
    assert body["location"] == "Riverside Park"

    # optional fields echo back
    assert body["distance"] == "5K"
    assert body["pace_target"] == "9:00-10:00/mi"
    assert body["route_notes"] == "Meet at the north gate"

    # initial participant state
    assert body["participant_count"] == 0
    assert body["participants"] == []


def test_create_run_rejects_empty_title(client):
    """A blank/whitespace-only title yields a 422 validation_error envelope."""
    resp = client.post(
        "/runs",
        json={
            "title": "   ",
            "datetime": "2025-08-15T07:00:00Z",
            "location": "Riverside Park",
        },
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    envelope = resp.json()
    assert "error" in envelope
    assert envelope["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GET /runs — list
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_list_runs_contains_created_run(client):
    """After creating a run, GET /runs returns a list that includes it."""
    created = _create_run(client, title="List Test Run")

    resp = client.get("/runs")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    runs = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(runs, list)
    assert len(runs) == 1
    assert runs[0]["id"] == created["id"]
    assert runs[0]["title"] == "List Test Run"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GET /runs/{run_id} — retrieve by id
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_get_run_by_id_returns_correct_fields(client):
    """Retrieving an existing run by id returns the stored fields."""
    created = _create_run(client, title="Detail Run", location="Central Plaza")

    resp = client.get(f"/runs/{created['id']}")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["id"] == created["id"]
    assert body["title"] == "Detail Run"
    assert body["location"] == "Central Plaza"
    assert body["participant_count"] == 0
    assert body["participants"] == []


def test_get_run_by_unknown_id_returns_404(client):
    """Retrieving a non-existent run id yields a 404 run_not_found envelope."""
    resp = client.get("/runs/nonexistent-id-12345")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    envelope = resp.json()
    assert envelope["error"]["code"] == "run_not_found"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POST /runs/{run_id}/participants — join
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_join_run_adds_participant_and_increments_count(client):
    """A valid join returns a Participant, adds the name, and bumps count."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    resp = client.post(
        f"/runs/{run_id}/participants",
        json={"name": "Alice"},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 201
    body = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(body["name"], str)
    assert body["name"] == "Alice"
    assert isinstance(body["joined_at"], str)

    # Verify via GET that the run was updated
    run = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}").json()
    assert "Alice" in run["participants"]
    assert run["participant_count"] == 1


def test_join_run_rejects_empty_name(client):
    """An empty participant name yields a 422 validation_error."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    resp = client.post(
        f"/runs/{run_id}/participants",
        json={"name": "   "},
    )
    assert resp.status_code == 422
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


def test_join_run_rejects_duplicate_name_case_insensitive(client):
    """Joining the same run twice with the same name (different case) → 409."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    # First join succeeds
    first = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/participants", json={"name": "Bob"})
    assert first.status_code == 201

    # Second join with different case is rejected
    second = client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/participants", json={"name": "BOB"})
    assert second.status_code == 409
    assert second.json()["error"]["code"] == "duplicate_participant"

    # Count unchanged
    run = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}").json()
    assert run["participant_count"] == 1
    assert len(run["participants"]) == 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DELETE /runs/{run_id}/participants/{name} — leave
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_leave_run_removes_participant_and_decrements_count(client):
    """A valid leave removes the participant and decrements the count."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    # Join first
    client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/participants", json={"name": "Carol"})
    run_before = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}").json()
    assert run_before["participant_count"] == 1
    assert "Carol" in run_before["participants"]

    # Leave
    resp = client.delete(f"/runs/{run_id}/participants/Carol")
    assert resp.status_code == 204

    # Verify removal
    run_after = client.get(f"/runs/{run_id}").json()
    assert run_after["participant_count"] == 0
    assert run_after["participants"] == []


def test_leave_run_rejects_unknown_participant(client):
    """Leaving with a name not on the run yields a 404 participant_not_found."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    resp = client.delete(f"/runs/{run_id}/participants/UnknownPerson")
    assert resp.status_code == 404
    assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "participant_not_found"


def test_leave_run_rejects_empty_name(client):
    """Leaving with an empty/whitespace name yields a 422 validation_error."""
    created = _create_run(client)
    run_id = created["id"]

    # Join a real participant so the run exists
    client.post(f"/runs/{run_id}/participants", json={"name": "Dave"})

    # Attempt to leave with a blank name (encoded as a path segment)
    resp = client.delete(f"/runs/{run_id}/participants/")
    # The route may interpret trailing slash differently; if it doesn't 422,
    # the empty path segment is stripped by the framework.  In that case the
    # framework returns 404 (no matching route) or the route receives "" as
    # the name.  Per the contract, empty name → validation_error → 422.
    assert resp.status_code in (404, 422)
    if resp.status_code == 422:
        assert resp.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"
